full_page.content:
1940, August 1
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
August 1st 1940.
Capuchin Monastery Glenclyffe Garrison, N.Y. Miss Winifred Goodwillie 228 N. LaSalle St. Chicago, Illinois
Dear Miss Goodwillie:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your kind favor of July 17th. I am sure Fr. Lambert acknowledged same befor.
Leaving for a trip to see an invalid brother of mine in Baltimore. I took your letter along hoping to answer it as it deserves to be answered; but I find myself almost as busy on my "vacation as in the office in Detroit.
However, before I leave here as expected right after dinner, I want to assure you of my appreciation and that I shall surely include Joseph O' Donnell in my poor prayers as well as yourself.
Now it's time and for the present I'll say Goodbye and again
God bless you. Fr. Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap.
